none: PAS FindID 985835: Roman Coin: Radiate indeterminate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of an indeterminate ruler on a small oval flan, later Roman issue of 260-296, possibly irregular. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped right, bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP C [---]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left holding object aloft, with a lowered ?torch in left hand. Reverse inscription: A A [---]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 1.67gms, die axis: 12
